question.title: Element Appearing More Than 25% In Sorted Array
question.translatedTitle: 有序数组中出现次数超过25%的元素
question.content:
Given an integer array sorted in non-decreasing order, there is exactly one integer in the array that occurs more than 25% of the time, return that integer.

 

Example 1:

Input: arr = [1,2,2,6,6,6,6,7,10]
Output: 6

Example 2:

Input: arr = [1,1]
Output: 1

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= arr.length <= 104
  • 0 <= arr[i] <= 105
